papers.title: What Is the Role for Humans in Creative Writing? Creativity and Diversity in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.reason: Excluded because the paper primarily evaluates human-AI and all-AI creative writing performance rather than modelling human executive function.

papers.title: Benchmarking Learning-Based Formula 1 Race Strategies
papers.reason: Excluded because it is an engineering optimization and reinforcement-learning benchmark for Formula 1 strategy with no grounding in human or animal cognition.

papers.title: The successor representation in high-risk drinking and alcohol-related contexts
papers.reason: The paper uses reinforcement-learning strategy models to dissociate successor-representation, model-based, and model-free control in human decision making under addiction-relevant contexts.

papers.title: Susceptibility to task-irrelevant auditory distractors in relation to visual working memory in children with and without attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder.
papers.reason: The title indicates a human study of distractor susceptibility, visual working memory, and ADHD, directly relevant to behavioural mechanisms of attention and executive control.

papers.title: Impact of hearing loss on visual selective attention: Evidence from N2pc and resting-state networks.
papers.reason: The paper reports task-based EEG, resting-state network, and behavioural findings on human visual selective attention that could directly inform models of attentional control.

papers.title: Content Validity and Psychometric Properties Assessment of the Virtual Reality Functional Capacity Assessment Tool and Application in Multiregional Clinical Trials of Cognitive Impairment Associated with Schizophrenia
papers.reason: The paper validates a VR-based performance outcome measure for cognitive impairment in schizophrenia, relevant to digital cognitive assessment but not specifically centred on executive-function modelling.

papers.title: Resource-Rational Encoding of Reward Information in Working Memory During Planning
papers.reason: Core contribution is a computational and behavioural model of how humans allocate working memory resources during planning and sequential decision-making.

papers.title: An automated pipeline for adult and developmental neuropsychological assessment of executive functions and metacognition based on a multi-layer neuropsychological digital-twin framework
papers.reason: Presents a computationally modelled digital-twin pipeline for individual executive-function and metacognitive assessment using WCST-based tasks, including developmental and ADHD-relevant cases.

papers.title: Stress-induced dorsal striatal dopamine release is associated with changes in functional connectivity to the prefrontal cortex in nicotine-dependent individuals—a preliminary report
papers.reason: Reports PET and rs-fMRI findings on stress-related striatal-prefrontal circuitry relevant to inhibition and decision-making, but executive function is indirect and the cohort is very small.

papers.title: Conceptual framework for emotion control integrating empathy, emotional regulation, and flexibility
papers.reason: Addresses emotion regulation and coping flexibility as executive-function-related constructs using questionnaires, but has limited computational or neurocognitive specificity for planning, working memory, or attention.

papers.title: Memory System, Processing Stages and Neural Mechanisms: A Review of Normal Function and Disorder Patterns
papers.reason: A broad narrative review of human memory systems, neural substrates, and disorders that includes working-memory impairment but is not centrally focused on executive-function modelling or assessment.

papers.title: A modernized picture description task enables detection of mild cognitive impairment through automated multimodal speech analysis in an open-source pipeline (SPEECH-MARC)
papers.reason: Develops an automated behavioural speech-based pipeline for classifying MCI status, relevant to digital cognitive biomarkers despite not focusing specifically on executive-function modelling or EEG/eye tracking.
